title: Studio Dev Mode Preview
desc: The authoritative UI preview path for plugin development.
lede: Dev Mode is how you preview a plugin's UI and behavior inside Studio while you build it.
body:
In progress — Dev Mode is being finalized in Phase 12.
At a glance
  • Preview the plugin's UI in Studio.
  • Drive it with scenario fixtures from the plugin.
  • Use it as you build.

What it previews

Dev Mode renders your plugin's settings and flows the way users will see them, so you can iterate without a full release loop.

Scenario fixtures

Plugins ship fixtures that drive the preview, giving deterministic scenarios to check against while developing.
